text: DSH WorkBuddy Connect Community（DSH 插件，Web 与 TUI 客户端）：复用已登录的 WorkBuddy 国内版或 WorkBuddy AI 国际版，为 DeepSeek Harness 接入模型。插件分别维护两种产品的凭据、模型目录和请求路由，并将聊天请求交由对应服务处理。功能包括更新可用模型、展示额度信息、手动探测部分模型的推理等级，以及在设置界面管理账号状态和模型显示。适合希望在 DSH 中使用 WorkBuddy 桌面账号模型的用户；需要登录对应桌面账号，不需单独填写 API Key。

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Community adds WorkBuddy and WorkBuddy AI providers to DSH using a desktop sign-in. It serves separate China and international catalogs, routes chat requests to each service, and supports model browsing and reasoning probes. Requires a signed-in account; no separate API key.

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Community 的功能「双版本模型接入」：读取 WorkBuddy 国内版或国际版桌面登录，并注册对应 DSH provider；模型目录和聊天请求均按产品版本路由。
DSH WorkBuddy Connect Community 的功能「模型目录与额度显示」：根据当前登录产品读取模型配置，并把模型信息交给 DSH 模型选择器；可展示目录提供的额度信息，供用户辨认不同模型。
DSH WorkBuddy Connect Community 的功能「推理等级探测」：用户可在会话界面针对符合条件的模型手动发起探测，插件记录结果并用于模型选项；探测请求通过插件的控制路由提交。
DSH WorkBuddy Connect Community 的功能「账号与模型设置卡片」：在 DSH 插件设置页面显示两种 WorkBuddy 产品的卡片，可检查状态并控制模型显示；国际版还提供上下文窗口偏好设置。

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Community README · DSH WorkBuddy Connect Community：[English](./README.en.md) | 中文

由 Tang Yixiao 维护的社区分叉，基于 Corrine Hu 的 MIT 项目 [`dsh-workbuddy-connect`](https://github.com/corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect)，保留其原有功能与版权。本项目面向已验证的 DeepSeek Harness 版本，复用本机已登录的 WorkBuddy（国内版）或 WorkBuddy AI（国际版），并保留 `workbuddy` / `workbuddy-ai` provider ID、现有账号数据和设置。

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Community README · DSH WorkBuddy Connect Community：社区版还对发往服务端的 system/developer 提示词做有限的产品称谓兼容处理，仅替换普通说明文本及已验证的固定 DSH 说明句中的精确称谓。用户、助手和工具消息、工具定义、图片块及文本块元数据保持原样；围栏代码块会跳过处理。普通文本中包含路径分隔符、引号、代码标记或可识别文件扩展名的行也会跳过，唯一额外处理是行首精确匹配已验证的 DSH 固定说明句时替换该句内的称谓，同一行后续内容保持原样。没有任何标记的纯文字文件名无法可靠地与正文区分，建议用反引号标记。这项本地处理不代表官方支持，也不保证上游服务持续可用。

0.1.14 修复上游流中断时桥接层拼接结束标记，导致误报 JSON 错误或将中断误判为成功的问题。该修复不能证明所有上游格式错误都由同一原因造成。

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Community README · 安装或替换：正式版 **`0.1.14`** 的 DSH 声明范围为 **`0.2.1-rc.2 || 0.2.1-rc.3 || 0.2.1-rc.5 || 0.2.2-rc.1`**，其他 RC 和正式版需要另行验证。0.2.2-rc.1 的隔离宿主测试验证了 provider 注册；真实模型生成尚未验收。该版本保留 rc.5 兼容声明，并在模型菜单的“模型”和“推理等级”下方及插件上下文标签页提供上游声明的窗口档位选择。选择按版本、账号和模型保存，直接影响 DSH 的上下文预算；模型不提供档位时不显示选择框。国内 CLI 目录缺少档位时，仅使用当前个人账号最近 24 小时内的桌面产品配置，按模型 ID 和最大输入上限精确匹配；无可验证配置时不展示选项。Windows 国内版已通过只读目录核验，返回 16 个模型，用户已确认 DSH 模型列表显示；真实模型生成及 WorkBuddy AI 国际版的实时请求尚未验收。macOS 和 Linux 尚未进行本分叉的实时验证。

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Community README · 安装或替换：**DSH Desktop**：在「扩展 → 插件管理 → 添加插件」中选择下载的 `.tgz` 文件完成安装或更新。Desktop profile 由桌面应用管理；下面的 CLI 示例用于独立 Web profile。安装后先保持社区版禁用，停用原版 `dsh-workbuddy-connect`，再启用社区版；保留原版及配置以便回退。原版与社区版只能启用一份，避免重复注册 provider。

从 [GitHub 正式发布](https://github.com/tangyixiao/dsh-workbuddy-connect-community/releases/tag/v0.1.14) 下载并按 DSH 支持的插件安装方式安装独立包：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/tangyixiao/dsh-workbuddy-connect-community/releases/download/v0.1.14/dsh-workbuddy-connect-community-0.1.14.tgz
```

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Community README · 安装或替换：如原版插件已安装，先保存当前版本和配置，再通过 DSH 支持的方式替换为社区版。原版与社区版不能同时启用；两者使用相同的 provider ID 和账号登录数据。失败时卸载社区版并恢复先前保存的原版。不要删除 WorkBuddy 登录信息或聊天数据。0.1.14 也已发布到 [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-workbuddy-connect-community/v/0.1.14)。

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Community README · 与 ZCode 共存：在 Windows Desktop 上，曾验证社区版与 [`dsh-zcode-plan-bridge`](https://github.com/tangyixiao/dsh-zcode-plan-bridge) 0.4.0 热加载共存：前者使用桌面登录并提供 `workbuddy` / `workbuddy-ai`，后者使用已登录的 CLI 账号并提供 `zcode-cli`；模型选择器可列出三个提供方。这是当时的版本和本机验证，不代表所有版本组合均已验证。`doctor` 和模型目录检查反映本机准备状态；账号计划是否有可用额度，需要实际请求确认。

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Community README · 兼容性与限制：插件直接复用 WorkBuddy 桌面应用的登录状态与服务接口，模型目录、请求和额度显示依赖第三方服务状态。服务接口可能变化或不可用；社区维护不意味着 WorkBuddy、腾讯或 DeepSeek 的授权或背书。请遵守相关服务条款。

本软件不包含账号凭据、用户会话或运行时数据。凭据只从本机应用或 DSH 自己保存的凭据副本读取。

0.1.12 中的国内版与国际版 Web 状态、控制接口均通过 DSH `connection.admit()` 校验宿主登录身份，仅允许 owner 访问。匿名或登录已失效的请求返回 401，其他身份返回 403；控制请求还需通过 Host/Origin 和 `probeKey` 校验。响应禁止缓存；缺少宿主 `connection` 服务时不挂载这些接口，模型提供方和 CLI 仍可用于无 Web 的 profile。此安全修复从 0.1.12 起提供。

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Community README · 诊断与可分享报告：以下 `--share` 功能包含在 0.1.12 中，0.1.10 包不包含该功能。运行 `dsh-workbuddy-connect-community doctor --share` 可生成可复制的 JSON 诊断报告；国际版使用 `dsh-workbuddy-connect-community doctor --share --provider workbuddy-ai`。该报告只包含版本、运行时、平台、架构、provider、登录文件是否存在及格式、登录状态和已知原因码、主机心跳状态、内置模型数，以及安全的应用版本来源标记。报告不含本地路径、账号标识、进程号、时间戳或自由文本错误。`readiness.authentication` 的 `credential-found` 仅表示凭据可被本地解析，不验证访问令牌是否仍有效，也不尝试刷新；`readiness.liveInference` 固定为 `not-tested`，命令不会发送模型请求。若本地诊断读取失败，命令仍会输出仅含固定 `diagnostic-unavailable` 错误码的 JSON。报告不代表服务可用。

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Community README · 诊断与可分享报告：普通 `doctor` 输出仍用于本机排查；已知原因码是稳定枚举，可用于判断下一步。`no-credential` 表示没有可用登录凭据；`encrypted-credential-unreadable` 表示加密凭据无法解锁；`electron-binary-not-found`、`electron-binary-ambiguous`、`electron-binary-unavailable`、`electron-path-invalid` 和 `electron-discovery-incomplete` 分别说明辅助程序未找到、候选不唯一、平台未提供自动发现、指定路径无效或发现流程未完成；`credential-region-mismatch` 表示凭据属于另一个 WorkBuddy 产品。未知原因码不会进入共享报告。

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Community README · DSH WorkBuddy Connect Community：[中文](./README.md) | English

A community-maintained fork by Tang Yixiao of Corrine Hu's MIT-licensed [`dsh-workbuddy-connect`](https://github.com/corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect). It targets the explicitly supported DeepSeek Harness releases and reuses a locally signed-in WorkBuddy (China) or WorkBuddy AI (international) desktop app. The existing `workbuddy` and `workbuddy-ai` provider IDs, account data, and settings are retained.

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Community README · DSH WorkBuddy Connect Community：The community fork also applies a narrow, exact product-name transform to plain system/developer prose and one verified fixed DSH explanatory sentence. User, assistant, and tool messages, tool definitions, image blocks, and text-block metadata remain unchanged. Fenced code blocks are skipped. Ordinary lines containing path separators, quotes, code markers, or recognizable filename extensions are also skipped. The sole additional rule matches the verified complete DSH sentence at the start of a line and changes its product name while preserving the rest of that line. Unmarked plain-word filenames cannot reliably be distinguished from prose; mark these literals with backticks. This local transform does not imply official support or guarantee upstream availability.

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Community README · DSH WorkBuddy Connect Community：Version 0.1.14 fixes the bridge appending a completion sentinel after an upstream stream error, which could produce malformed JSON or falsely report success. This does not establish the cause of every malformed upstream event.

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Community README · Install or replace：Release **`0.1.14`** declares DSH **`0.2.1-rc.2 || 0.2.1-rc.3 || 0.2.1-rc.5 || 0.2.2-rc.1`**; other RCs and stable releases require separate qualification. Isolated host testing verified provider registration on 0.2.2-rc.1; live inference has not been verified. It retains rc.5 compatibility and offers per-model context choices in the composer model menu and in plugin settings where the catalog declares tiers. Choices are stored separately by product and account and set the DSH context budget; models without declared tiers have no selector. When the CN CLI catalog omits tiers, a personal account can use a desktop product snapshot less than 24 hours old, joined by exact model ID and input cap; otherwise no tier is inferred. A read-only catalogue check returned 16 models for the Windows China client, and the user confirmed that the DSH model picker displayed them. Authenticated model generation and live WorkBuddy AI requests have not been accepted. macOS and Linux have not been live-verified for this fork.

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Community README · Install or replace：**DSH Desktop:** use Extensions → Plugin Management → Add Plugin and select the downloaded `.tgz` to install or update it. The desktop app manages its profile; the CLI example below is for a standalone Web profile. Keep the community package disabled after installation, disable the original `dsh-workbuddy-connect`, then enable the community package. Retain the original and its configuration for rollback. Enable only one package to avoid duplicate provider registration.

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Community README · Install or replace：Download the package from the [GitHub release](https://github.com/tangyixiao/dsh-workbuddy-connect-community/releases/tag/v0.1.14) and install it through a DSH-supported plugin method:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/tangyixiao/dsh-workbuddy-connect-community/releases/download/v0.1.14/dsh-workbuddy-connect-community-0.1.14.tgz
```

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Community README · Install or replace：If the original plugin is installed, save its current version and configuration, then replace it through a DSH-supported method. The original and community plugins must not be enabled together: they use the same provider IDs and account login data. If replacement fails, remove the community package and restore the saved original. Do not delete WorkBuddy sign-in data or chat data. Version 0.1.14 is also published on [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-workbuddy-connect-community/v/0.1.14).

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Community README · Coexistence with ZCode：Hot-loaded coexistence with [`dsh-zcode-plan-bridge`](https://github.com/tangyixiao/dsh-zcode-plan-bridge) 0.4.0 was verified on Windows Desktop: this package uses desktop sign-in and provides `workbuddy` / `workbuddy-ai`, while the ZCode plugin uses the signed-in CLI account and provides `zcode-cli`; the model picker can list all three providers. This is evidence for that version and local setup, not all version combinations. `doctor` and catalog checks establish local readiness; available account-plan quota must be confirmed by an actual request.

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Community README · Compatibility and limits：The plugin reuses the desktop app's sign-in and service interfaces. Model catalogs, requests, and credit displays depend on the third-party service, which can change or become unavailable. Community maintenance does not mean authorization or endorsement by WorkBuddy, Tencent, or DeepSeek. Follow the applicable service terms.

The package contains no account credentials, user sessions, or runtime data. Credentials are read from the local app or a credential copy stored by DSH itself.

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Community README · Compatibility and limits：Version 0.1.12 authenticates both variants' Web status and control routes through DSH `connection.admit()` and permits only the Host owner. Anonymous or expired sessions receive 401; other principals receive 403. Controls also require the Host/Origin checks and `probeKey`. Responses are not cached. Without the Host `connection` service, these routes are not mounted; the provider and CLI remain available in headless profiles. This security fix is included starting with 0.1.12.

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Community README · Diagnostics and shareable reports：The `--share` feature below is included in 0.1.12; the 0.1.10 package does not include it. Run `dsh-workbuddy-connect-community doctor --share` to print copyable JSON. For the international app, use `dsh-workbuddy-connect-community doctor --share --provider workbuddy-ai`. The report is limited to package/runtime/platform/architecture versions, provider, auth-file presence and format, sign-in state and a known reason code, host heartbeat state, fallback model count, and a safe app-version source label. It omits local paths, account identifiers, process IDs, timestamps, and free-text errors. `readiness.authentication: credential-found` means the local credential parsed; it does not validate token freshness or attempt a refresh. `readiness.liveInference` is always `not-tested`: the command sends no model request. If a local diagnostic read fails, the command still prints JSON with only the fixed `diagnostic-unavailable` error code. The report does not establish service availability.

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Community README · Diagnostics and shareable reports：Use ordinary `doctor` output for local troubleshooting. Known reason codes are stable diagnostic categories: `no-credential` means there is no usable sign-in; `encrypted-credential-unreadable` means an encrypted credential could not be opened; `electron-binary-not-found`, `electron-binary-ambiguous`, `electron-binary-unavailable`, `electron-path-invalid`, and `electron-discovery-incomplete` describe a missing or ambiguous helper, unsupported automatic discovery, an invalid configured path, or an incomplete discovery attempt; `credential-region-mismatch` means the credential belongs to the other WorkBuddy product. Unknown reason codes are omitted from the shareable report.

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Community README · Diagnostics and shareable reports：| Platform | Validation evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Windows | Previously accepted in a local run |
| macOS | No live local validation |
| Linux | No live local validation |

Windows, macOS, and Linux inputs in cross-platform tests are simulated fixtures; they do not establish runtime acceptance on those systems. Diagnostics do not guarantee WorkBuddy service availability.
